title: Homogeneous twist sections cut out standard opens on the invertibility locus
statement: Let $A=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}A_n$ be a nonnegatively graded commutative ring, $P=\operatorname{Proj}(A)$ [def-pc-proj]. Fix $d\geq1$, and let $W_d\subseteq P$ be the largest open subscheme on which every $\mathcal O_P(nd)|_{W_d}$ is invertible and all multiplication maps $\mathcal O_P(nd)|_{W_d}\otimes\mathcal O_P(md)|_{W_d}\to\mathcal O_P((n+m)d)|_{W_d}$ are isomorphisms (equivalently, the union of standard opens $D_+(ab)$ with homogeneous $a,b$ and $\deg(a)=\deg(b)+d$). If $U\subseteq W_d$ is an open subscheme [def-weil-open-immersion] and $f\in A_{nd}$ is homogeneous for some $n\geq1$, let $s_f\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U(nd))$ be the restriction of the canonical section. Then its nonvanishing locus is $U_{s_f}=U\cap D_+(f)$. As $f$ ranges over positive-degree homogeneous elements whose degrees are multiples of $d$ (and their positive powers), these loci form a basis of the topology of $U$; the affine such loci form an affine-open basis.

source.place: Tag 01MV (lemma-principal-open), with Tag 01MW (lemma-ample-on-proj), clauses (5)--(7), and Tag 01MS (lemma-where-invertible).

proof.text: Use the union characterization of $W_d$ in the hypothesis. Its covering charts are $V=D_+(ab)$ with $\alpha=\deg(a)$, $\beta=\deg(b)$, $\alpha=\beta+d$; put $h=ab$ and $k=\alpha+\beta>0$. By [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf], sections of $\mathcal O_P(nd)$ on $V$ are the degree-$nd$ fractions in $A_h$. Both $a$ and $b$ are units in $A_h$, since their product is inverted. Thus $e=(a/b)^n=a^{2n}/h^n$ has degree $nd$, its inverse has degree $-nd$, and multiplication by $e$ identifies $(A_h)_0$ with $(A_h)_{nd}$: the inverse sends $t$ to $e^{-1}t$. These formulas commute with localization restrictions, so they give an isomorphism of sheaves $\mathcal O_V\simeq\mathcal O_P(nd)|_V$. The canonical section restricts to $f/1=c e$, with $c=b^nf/a^n\in(A_h)_0$. This is a direct fraction calculation from the cited definition, including when $V$ is empty.

source.place: Tags 01MU (lemma-where-invertible), first paragraph of proof, and 01MV (lemma-principal-open), chart calculation.

proof.text: Fix a chart from Step 1 and a point $x\in U\cap V$. Nonvanishing means $s_{f,x}\notin\mathfrak m_x\mathcal O_U(nd)_x$, by [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. In the basis $e$ this is $c_x\notin\mathfrak m_x$, equivalently $c_x$ is a unit. The degree-zero fraction $u=b^{2n\alpha}/a^{2n\beta}$ is a unit of $(A_h)_0$, with inverse $a^{2n\beta}/b^{2n\alpha}$. Direct multiplication, using $d=\alpha-\beta$, gives $c^k=u f^k/h^{nd}$. In any commutative local ring a positive power is a unit exactly when its base is a unit; multiplication by a unit does not change this. Therefore $c_x$ is a unit exactly when $(f^k/h^{nd})_x$ is. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-proj-basic-open-intersection] with its chart element $h\in A_k$ and second element $f\in A_{nd}$: this unit locus is precisely $V\cap D_+(f)$. Both degrees are positive. Consequently $U_{s_f}\cap V=U\cap V\cap D_+(f)$. The charts cover $U$, so equality of these sets on every chart gives $U_{s_f}=U\cap D_+(f)$.

source.place: Tag 01MV (lemma-principal-open), principal open of the coefficient; Tag 01M4 (lemma-standard-open) (1)(f) / 01MA (lemma-standard-open-proj).

proof.text: Let $x\in U$ and let $N\subseteq U$ be an open neighbourhood. Since $U$ is open in $P$, $N$ is also open in $P$. The positive-degree basis clause of [lem-weil-pbc-proj-standard-open-inclusion] gives a homogeneous $g\in A_q$, $q>0$, with $x\in D_+(g)\subseteq N$. Put $f=g^d\in A_{qd}$, so its degree is divisible by $d$. For every homogeneous prime $\mathfrak p$, primality gives $g^d\notin\mathfrak p$ if and only if $g\notin\mathfrak p$ because $d\geq1$. Thus $D_+(f)=D_+(g)\subseteq U$, and Step 2 gives $U_{s_f}=D_+(g)$. Every prescribed neighbourhood therefore contains one of the stated loci through its point; all these loci are open since $D_+(f)$ is open. This proves the basis assertion without quasi-compactness of $U$.

source.place: Tag 01MW (lemma-ample-on-proj), (5)--(6), with the standard-open basis of 01M4; no finite subcover is needed.

proof.text: The loci chosen in Step 3 equal whole standard opens $D_+(g)\subseteq U$. By the affine-chart clause of [def-pc-proj], each is the affine scheme $\operatorname{Spec}(A_{(g)})$. Hence for every point and neighbourhood in $U$ there is an affine member of the stated family inside that neighbourhood. This proves that its affine members form an affine-open basis. We do not assert that an arbitrary intersection $U\cap D_+(f)$ is affine. When $U$ is empty all the equalities and basis conditions are vacuous; when $f=0$ or is nilpotent, the chart calculation yields the empty nonvanishing locus as required.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01MU (lemma-where-invertible), 01MV (lemma-principal-open), and 01MW (lemma-ample-on-proj) (5)--(7), with the coefficient-locus calculation expanded via 01MA.
